verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships as an official TypeScript package (npm install better-auth). It provides a documented client SDK (authClient methods such as signUp.email) and a server API (auth.api methods), with framework integrations for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ more, so developers can build directly against first-party SDKs. A hands-on report says the client library is JS-only, with virtually no documentation for writing other-language clients, which limits non-JS platforms. missing for 10: official non-JavaScript SDKs (e.g., iOS/native mobile), documentation for building custom clients, an OpenAPI spec for SDK generation (probe found none).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To sign up a user you need to call the client method `signUp.email`
To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the auth.api methods.
